lines.text: The LORD tells them to ask for the ancient paths, but they refuse to walk in them or listen.
The LORD brings disaster because they rejected His instruction, and He says frankincense from Egypt is of no use to Him.
An army from the north, cruel and merciless, rides upon horses against the Daughter of Zion.
Their hands hang limp, and they are told to mourn with bitter wailing as for an only brother.
They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.
